hero.title: Over 30 Years of Experience in Automotive Spare Parts
hero.subtitle:
D&W has been serving Myanmar's automotive spare parts industry since 1995, building expertise in

OEM spare parts

, vehicle compatibility, reliable sourcing, and customer service.

intro.title: Built on Experience. Moving Forward with Technology.
intro.p1: D&W began its operations in 1995, initially as a pen-related business before transitioning into the automotive spare parts industry. Over the years, the company developed a strong understanding of automotive spare parts, OEM information, product compatibility, and sourcing.
intro.p2: Today, D&W combines decades of industry experience with modern technology to make automotive spare-parts sourcing more accurate, transparent, and efficient.

m1.title: The Beginning
m1.p1: D&W began its operations in 1995, initially as a pen-related business before transitioning into the automotive spare parts industry. The company entered the market with air filter color-changing machinery and gradually expanded its product range, with a strong focus on valve cover gaskets and brake shoes.
m1.p2: Over the years, D&W built a reliable supplier network across Taiwan, China, South Korea, and Japan.

m2.title: Expanding Automotive Expertise
m2.p1: In 2006, one of D&W's founders returned to Myanmar and became fully involved in the company's operations.
m2.p2: During this period, D&W also imported and sold selected Japanese vehicles, allowing the company to develop a deeper understanding of OEM numbers, vehicle compatibility, and spare-parts applications.

m3.title: Moving Into the Digital Era
m3.p1:
In 2026, D&W entered a new stage of growth by developing a

Digital B2B Platform

together with an integrated ERP inventory management system.
m3.p2: This transformation aims to improve inventory accuracy, streamline order processing, strengthen customer service, and provide more efficient and reliable delivery timelines for customers across Myanmar.
